## Order health check (hourly)
Read only. Flags orders on integrated channels (Shopify, Amazon, Faire, TikTok) older than `graceMinutes` that are draft / quotation / failed, confirmed with no shipment, or carry an open exception. Emails only NEW problems (static data remembers what was sent).

Built by Claude for Ben 23-Oct-26. Starts on SANDBOX. To go live: Settings tenant/baseUrl = PROD and switch the 3 read nodes to the Fulfil PROD credential.
